name: Infecting Telepathy
description: If a creature communicates telepathically with the creature, or uses a psychic attack against it, the creature can spread its disease to the creature. The creature must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom save or become infected with the same disease caused by the creature’s tentacle attack. This ability replaces an aboleth’s Probing Telepathy ability.
